title: NonNegativeQuantitySchedule
description: Specifies a quantity schedule where all the values must be non-negative.

value.description: The initial rate or amount, as the case may be. An initial rate of 5% would be represented as 0.05.

datedValue.description: The schedule of step date and value pairs. On each step date the associated step value becomes effective. A list of steps may be ordered in the document by ascending step date. An FpML document containing an unordered list of steps is still regarded as a conformant document.

unit.description: Qualifies the unit by which the amount is measured. Optional because a measure may be unit-less (e.g. when representing a ratio between amounts in the same unit).
Requires that a unit of amount must be specified for any quantity.

multiplier.description: Defines an optional measure that the quantity should be multiplied by to derive a total quantity. Requires that the multiplier must be positive. This number is associated to an optional unit. For example in the case of the Coal (API2) CIF ARA (ARGUS-McCloskey) Futures Contract on the CME, where the unit would be contracts, the multiplier value would 1,000 and the mulitiplier unit would be 1,000 MT (Metric Tons).

frequency.description: Defines the frequency to be used when defining a quantity. For example a quantity may be specified as a number of barrels of oil per day, which needs multiplying by the number of days in the relevant period to get the total quantity as a number of barrels.

total.description: Specifies the total quantity when the quantity itself is specified with a frequency.

value.description: For a non-negative quantity schedule, all amount attribute must be positive.

datedValue.description: For a non-negative quantity schedule, all amount attribute must be positive.

total.description: For a non-negative quantity schedule, all amount attribute must be positive.
